about.title: Built for sun-baked land, like the acacia.
about.text: The acacia thrives where little else does: strong roots, little water, full sun. That is how we work. Acacia Engineering is a Jaipur team of solar engineers who size every system to your actual bill, install it cleanly, and keep it producing.

estimator.sub: Set your average monthly electricity bill. You get a rough system size to start the conversation. Our engineers confirm it after a site visit.
estimator.label: Monthly electricity bill
estimator.note: Indicative only. Assumes about ₹8 per unit and about 4.5 units per kW per day. Actual figures depend on your tariff, roof and shading.
